Name: Youth Day
Comments: Commemorates the Soweto uprising led by secondary school students in 1976.

Name: National Women's Day
Comments: Commemorates the 1956 March of approximately 20,000 women to petition against pass laws.

Name: Heritage Day
Comments: Recognises aspects of South African culture which are both tangible and difficult to pin down: creative expression, the historical inheritance, language, the food, and the land people live on.

Name: Day of Reconciliation
Comments: Honors both the Black and White soldiers who died in the Battle of Blood River in 1838.
